tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Inspect actual software connection, units, stages and validation limits.

tools.name: project_init
tools.description: Create one current fact record; existing projects are never overwritten.

tools.name: project_get
tools.description: Read current facts, decisions, checks, pending issues and revision.

tools.name: project_link_authority
tools.description: Link an existing JSON fact table as sole semantic authority. Refresh only after reading/reconciling its actual changes.

tools.name: project_update
tools.description: Update current regions/relations/models, retaining revision history. Dimensions use metres.

tools.name: decision_record
tools.description: Record the actual user decision with a retrievable source; never invent user approval.

tools.name: stage_check
tools.description: List stage conditions, stale evidence and required user decisions.

tools.name: stage_advance
tools.description: Advance one stage only after evidence and design decision conditions are met.

tools.name: stage_reopen
tools.description: Return to an affected earlier stage without erasing facts or old evidence.

tools.name: evidence_register
tools.description: Read and bind a real scoped report and its current source files. Does not prove its assertions.

tools.name: sketchup_state
tools.description: Inspect actual document identity, unsaved changes, disk drift, scene and live revision.

tools.name: sketchup_new
tools.description: Create a new saved workspace document only after preserving any current unsaved work.

tools.name: sketchup_open
tools.description: Open a saved workspace document; refuses to switch away from unsaved work.

tools.name: sketchup_query
tools.description: Find native instances and identities without dumping all geometry. Use IDs for editing.

tools.name: sketchup_create
tools.description: Create one editable native solid. Floor polygon Z is its structural bottom; choose finished-face conventions explicitly.

tools.name: sketchup_transform
tools.description: Apply a world-space column-major affine matrix once; translation is metres.

tools.name: sketchup_delete
tools.description: Delete declared objects. Explain preserved/replaced enclosure, support and protection; recheck old openings and finishes.

tools.name: sketchup_material
tools.description: Assign a local material without recoloring unrelated users of an existing material.

tools.name: sketchup_opening
tools.description: Cut only specified actual hosts. Stores original hosts and post-state for guarded restoration.

tools.name: sketchup_restore_opening
tools.description: Restore recorded host geometry only if the post-cut host has not changed.

tools.name: sketchup_combine
tools.description: Union explicit solid instances; preserves actual cavities. Inputs are replaced transactionally.

tools.name: sketchup_group
tools.description: Group explicit root-level sibling instances without boolean rebuilding their geometry/materials.

tools.name: sketchup_script
tools.description: Run trusted workspace Ruby inside a native transaction. Do not manage transactions or change documents/edit context in scripts. Declare existing geometry scopes, any new roots and scene names. This is code execution, not an OS sandbox.

tools.name: sketchup_save
tools.description: Save the authoritative current document; another existing output is never overwritten.

tools.name: sketchup_edit_context
tools.description: Enter a native instance editing path, or exit to the model when id is null. Finish any current GUI gesture before changing context; final save requires the root context.

tools.name: sketchup_undo
tools.description: Undo across a distinct native event-loop turn, then query/compare the result.

tools.name: sketchup_reopen
tools.description: Reopen a saved workspace model only when the native window has no unsaved edits, then export and compare.

tools.name: sketchup_probe_pushpull
tools.description: Temporarily push/pull a real upward native face. Undo in a separate call and verify restoration before saving.

tools.name: sketchup_export
tools.description: Export actual world geometry, native face rings, UV, materials, instance paths and scenes.

tools.name: sketchup_capture
tools.description: Capture the actual current native view for visual review; an image is not a geometry certificate.

tools.name: sketchup_scene
tools.description: Select an existing scene or save one explicitly requested camera; does not create diagnostic scene clutter.

tools.name: sketchup_import
tools.description: Import a workspace asset through SketchUp's native importer; inspect units and editability afterwards.

tools.name: native_job_status
tools.description: Resume the same native operation; never create a second write after a timeout.

tools.name: native_job_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a queued operation. Running native transactions finish atomically.

tools.name: asset_build
tools.description: Create/continue an independent editable Blender asset. Supply asset_id, new blend/glb/dae/preview paths, parts or trusted script, anchor and license sources.

tools.name: asset_job_status
tools.description: Return durable worker status, Blender exit code and saved/reimport verification.

tools.name: asset_job_cancel
tools.description: Cancel only this server-owned Blender worker group; incomplete outputs are invalid.

tools.name: checks_run
tools.description: Compute actual geometry checks. Inputs are IDs/contours/routes and project dimensions, not preset compliance rules.

tools.name: evidence_inherit
tools.description: Inherit only a check whose declared dependencies are actually unchanged and semantic basis is unchanged. Missing dependencies cannot be guessed.

tools.name: drawing_read_slice
tools.description: Read handoff geometry into a plan/section cut-segment draft; final drawing stays in the next workflow.

tools.name: handoff_export
tools.description: Freeze a stage-approved handoff with source hashes, actual geometry and explicit unverified scope.
